newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: PHILIPS TO SPEND S$62.5M ON R&D FACILITY.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPS TO SPEND S$62.5M ON R&D FACILITY.

text.p: Netherlands-based electronics giant Philips Electronics NV said on Monday it would invest a further Singapore $62.5 million over five years to expand its regional process research and development (R&D) facility in Singapore.

"Philips will invest a further S$62.5 million to expand and upgrade its Asia-Pacific Centre for Manufacturing Technology (CFT) into an independent, full-fledged manufacturing research and support centre," the company said in a statement.
The centre was first set up in 1994 as a satellite operation for the main CFT centre in the Netherlands, with its main research project the Flexline flexible manufacturing system.
The expansion programme will upgrade CFT Singapore into an autonomous regional R&D centre providing direct support to Philips factories in the Asia-Pacific.
